clips.title: The story
paras: At Bloodhoof Village, Taming the Beast begins a young tauren hunter’s training with Yaw Sharpmane. The first trial takes the hunter into Mulgore to tame an adult plainstrider and begin a bond with the creatures of the Earthmother.

Tauren hunters seek more than meat and hides when they hunt. Their ancestral traditions teach that meeting Mulgore’s wild creatures can bring a hunter closer to the Earthmother. Taming a companion turns a beast that might have been an adversary into a partner, joined with the hunter in the natural balance of the plains.

Yaw Sharpmane starts a hunter’s training with plainstriders that roam Mulgore’s grasslands. The hunter carries an enchanted taming rod and faces an adult plainstrider, calming its wild instincts and earning its trust. This first trial tests the hunter’s resolve and prepares them to face more demanding beasts.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: As a tauren, it is important to follow the traditions of our ancestors by fighting mighty creatures. By besting these creatures, we are able to intake their spirits, allowing us to become closer to the Earthmother.

In the same way, taming a beast to fight alongside us helps us become one with nature around us. Eventually, you will learn to tame a beast of your choosing. But all things take practice, and you have much to learn. Begin by taking this taming rod; you must tame an adult plainstrider.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Practice your skills, friend. Tame the adult plainstrider.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Signs have appeared to me from the Earthmother; you have done well.
